name: Persimmon
siboNotes: Well-tolerated on SIBO diets due to low FODMAP content. The natural sugars are easily absorbed in the small intestine.
preparationTips: Choose fully ripe persimmons for best digestibility and sweetness
Remove skin if experiencing any digestive sensitivity
Can be eaten fresh or dried in small portions
Pair with low-FODMAP nuts for balanced snacking
nutritionalHighlights: High in vitamin A and beta-carotene
